messages:
maria.sanders: heads up — CI alerted on the audit-event-validator again, failing 3x in the last hour on main :exclamation:

maria.sanders: logs show golden fixture diffs and also occasional KMS unwrap errors, not sure if they're related

jordan: I got a repro locally when running the full validator suite with --shuffle-seed=42, flake shows `actor_id: null` in 1/30 runs

kevin_w: repro steps? I want to check if this is an ingestion ordering race (rbac changes landed last week)

jordan: quick repro:
```bash
git checkout main
pytest tests/audit_validator/test_golden_fixtures.py::TestGoldenSet::test_matches -k \"smoke\" -s
# sometimes passes, sometimes prints: 'Missing field: kms_key_id'
```

maria.sanders: sample failing diff (trimmed):
```
- metadata.kms_key_id: \"projects/rdw/locations/global/keyRings/foo/cryptoKeys/bar\"
+ metadata.kms_key_id: null
- actor.id: \"svc:billing@redwood\"
+ actor.id: null
```

liz_rehm: :eyes: I saw a similar pattern yesterday in production ingest where RBAC delta caused a blank actor to be emitted for system events. Might be the same root cause

sre-oncall: deploy-bot just recorded a canary rollback at 22:02 UTC, maybe correlated. deploy-bot: @here canary rollback triggered on service/audit-ingest due to 5xx spike

kevin_w: ok — hypothesis: new rbac change introduces a codepath that emits placeholder actor before KMS unwrap completes. If golden fixtures are generated from upstream samples that include wrapped keys, CI verifier might intermittently see unwrap failures and treat them as nulls

maria.sanders: plan: 1) add an assertion in the validator to fail more verbosely when kms unwrap returns transient errors (EAGAIN/ETIMEDOUT), 2) pin a small canary fixture with unwrapped kms_key for CI to catch regressions, 3) open an issue to audit the RBAC rollout for any actor population changes

jordan: I'll open the issue and attach the local repro logs + seed. assigning to @kevin_w to look at unwrap path.

kevin_w: will triage today. quick mitigation: add retry for kms unwrap in test harness and mark golden with explicit kms_key in the meantime

maria.sanders: filed https://github.com/redwood-inference/platform/issues/4982 — added logs + sample diff. tagging @kevin_w @liz_rehm

liz_rehm: also suggest adding a CI flake detector job that runs the validator 5x and fails on >1 inconsistent result. that will catch non-deterministic flakes early

kevin_w: agree. I'll prototype a flaky-detect wrapper in eng-infra repo and push later today.

maria.sanders: thanks everyone. action items summarized: jordan -> repro & seed; kevin -> unwrap retry + infra probe; liz -> correlate prod ingest traces; maria -> add pinned canary fixture and improve validator error messages. leaving open until next deploy passes :thumbsup:

deploy-bot: deploy pipeline: service/audit-ingest rollback -> redeploy queued (build #5821)

sre-oncall: noted, will monitor error rate and audit-traffic sampling. escalate if >3% for 15m

maria.sanders: I'll follow up in the issue with next CI run results and attach flaky-detect job when available

jordan: thanks — will paste seed+logs to the issue once CI reproduces

liz_rehm: :rocket:
